senses.definition: one of the rivers of Eden Gn 2:13 (on theories of identity v. Comm.; also SmithDict. Bible Schaff-HerzogArt. Eden SpurrellText of Gen. ad loc. RiHWB).
spring of water near Jerusalem: גִּחוֹן 1 K 1:33, 38, 45, מֵימֵי גִוחוֹן הָעֶלְיוֹן 2 Ch 32:30, לְגִיחוֹן בַּנַּחַל 2 Ch 33:14;—there are two main theories as to locality:
W. of Jerusalem, connected with Birket Mamilla, and aqueduct into city RobBR i. 239, 345 ff. SurveyJerusalem al.;
E. of Jerusalem = Fountain of the Virgin, Furrer<sup>SchenkelBL ii. 463</sup> Bd<sup>Pal. 101</sup>, or Siloah water-system Guthe<sup>ZPV, v., 1882, 359 ff.</sup>
